calculation.expression: when VIX > rolling_quantile(VIX,252,0.70): -(rolling_sum(asset_return - cross_sectional_mean_return,3) / rolling_std(asset_return - cross_sectional_mean_return,20))
calculation.description: Within the 15-asset tradable benchmark universe, remove the contemporaneous cross-asset mean return, volatility-normalize each asset's three-session residual move, and fade the residual shock only during elevated VIX regimes. Signal is lagged one completed session for forward-return testing.

validation.regime_notes: Elevated-VIX active observations; all 960 observations had 15 valid instruments. Sparse regime activation warrants conservative interpretation in the 15-asset universe.
